nodes.summary: There are a natural number $n$, an element $w$ of the free group $F_n$ of rank $n$ and an automorphism $\varphi$ of $F_n$ such that $w, \varphi(w), \dots, \varphi^n(w)$ generate $F_n$ but $w, \varphi(w), \dots, \varphi^{n-1}(w)$ do not.
nodes.title: Bogopolski's Cayley–Hamilton analogue fails for free groups (Kourovka 17.32)

nodes.summary: The assertion that for every natural number $n$, every element $w$ of the free group $F_n$ of rank $n$ and every automorphism $\varphi$ of $F_n$, if $w, \varphi(w), \dots, \varphi^n(w)$ generate $F_n$, then already $w, \varphi(w), \dots, \varphi^{n-1}(w)$ generate $F_n$.
nodes.title: Bogopolski's Cayley–Hamilton question for free groups (Kourovka 17.32)
